description: A toothbrush, a small toothpaste tube, and a white paper cup sit on the tabletop in front of a pillow. The right hand reaches into the cup to take out the toothbrush, while the left hand picks up the toothpaste tube; both hands bring the brush and tube together, and the left-hand object is squeezed over the toothbrush bristles (right-hand object) to put toothpaste on, then the toothbrush is moved back toward the cup.
